newsitem.title: USA: Avondale Mills sets $40 million South Carolina expansion.
newsitem.headline: Avondale Mills sets $40 million South Carolina expansion.

text.p: Avondale Mills Inc. said Wednesday it is spending $40 million to expand its textile operations in Graniteville, S.C.
The company said it will build a new weaving facility and provide new technology for its Gregg finishing plant there.
It will also build a new distribution centre in nearby Sage Mill Industrial Park in Aiken County.
